commit_message: Finish Secondary Motion runtime naming cleanup
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up removes the temporary pre-cutover rigid-body aliases and compatibility facade, moves the remaining authoring/runtime Rust identifiers onto the current Secondary Motion names without changing the persisted `engine.secondary_motion` ID, and makes scene-bridge rollback restore the Secondary Motion rig registry exactly.

The PR remains Draft while the neutral model-IR/import naming cleanup, PMX best-effort conversion audit, documentation cleanup, and final validation are completed.
